priors.label: Baymard · 购物车放弃率（50 项研究 2006–2025 · 非加权均值约 70%）
priors.prior: Cart abandonment ~70%; ~1/3 of users who add a cart actually buy

priors.label: Nielsen Norman Group · 10 秒法则（首屏约五分之一用户立即离开）

verdicts.label: Baymard购物车放弃率 / Baymard cart abandonment
verdicts.whyZh: 队列没有加购与购买分母，5.8%是会话到结局，无法对齐购物车转化。
verdicts.whyEn: No add-to-cart or purchase denominator; 5.8% is session-to-ending conversion, so the prior is not comparable.

verdicts.label: NNG首屏10秒法则 / NNG 10-second rule
verdicts.whyZh: 55.3%是总体bounce，不是首屏或10秒内离开，缺少可比指标。
verdicts.whyEn: The 55.3% overall bounce rate is not first-paint or ten-second abandonment, so comparison lacks evidence.

verdicts.label: Contentsquare移动流量 / Contentsquare mobile share
verdicts.whyZh: 移动占比61.0%，与约60%的全球基准一致，仅有轻微正偏。
verdicts.whyEn: Mobile share is 61.0%, aligning closely with the roughly 60% global benchmark.

verdicts.label: StatCounter全球设备占比 / StatCounter worldwide device share
verdicts.whyEn: Mobile at 61.0% and desktop at 39.0% nearly exactly match 60.87% and 39.13%.

overall.verdictZh: 目前只能确认设备结构对齐；漏斗与离开行为尚未被这些先验有效验证。
overall.verdictEn: Only device mix aligns; funnel and exit behavior remain unvalidated by these priors.
overall.readyZh: 值得现在接，以影子采集开始

sensitivity.zh: Baymard购物车先验最敏感：必须补齐加购、结账、购买分母；其次是NNG的首屏10秒事件。
sensitivity.en: Baymard is most sensitive: add cart, checkout, and purchase denominators; next, capture first-paint and ten-second exits.
